status: DRAFT - freeze (and convert to experiment.protocol/v1) before any run
question: Does the default F4 path at SOURCE_REVISION run faster than the env-restored old path on many cores, with identical output?
order: per round, arms rotated by round index (A1,A2,B / A2,B,A1 / B,A1,A2); thread settings outermost per round
primary_metric: per-case median f4_ms ratio old/new, per thread count
noise_floor: per-case median f4_ms ratio A2/A1 with paired bootstrap 95% interval
decision: report ratio with interval; a ratio is admissible only where the A/A interval contains 1 and is narrower than the B/A effect
timing_admission: none: command Jobs carry no native L2 grade; wall-clock here is indicative (L0/L1 at most)
counters_note: counters may differ between arms only where the lead declares it (e.g. F4_FP_FL changes field_ops 399,396,830 vs 331,473,535 on quad_n9); they must be constant within an arm across rounds and thread counts
